name: Calligraphy
description: Eight lettering tools that carry a finite dip of ink and spend it: a broad edge and a parallel pen that cut thick and thin from a fixed angle, a pointed nib that only swells when pulled and splits when pushed too fast, a brush pen that streaks dry at speed, a ruling pen that throws what it holds, a folded pen that scratches itself out, a quill that blots when brim-full, and a reed qalam. Flick a loaded pen and it spatters. Rest the pen and the ink pools. The nib angle is yours to set, and holds still in the world when you turn the device.
author: HereLiesAz
